headline: BetterBags Next adds currency and item tracking in the backpack, a draggable floating tracker, and new currency settings.

entries.title: Currency strip and floating tracker in Next
entries.details: BetterBags Next now tracks currencies and stacking items in the backpack footer, complete with gain animations and cap indicators. Drag the strip out to create a floating on-screen tracker that stays visible with bags closed, Shift-drag items to reorder or untrack them, or drop stacking items directly onto the strip. A new Currencies settings section lets you customize layout, grow direction, scale, and visibility.

entries.title: Click currency rows to toggle tracking
entries.details: In the currency settings, clicking anywhere on a currency row now flips its switch on or off instead of requiring a click directly on the toggle.
